nodes.description: public pure function isValidBubbleBudz(uint id_) that validates a packed BubbleBudz id against a hardcoded address prefix and a low-order constant, returning bool.
Input parameter id_ of isValidBubbleBudz, a packed uint encoding address prefix and token suffix.
public pure function bubbleBudsGenesisId(uint tokenId_) that extracts the raw genesis id from a packed token id and subtracts a fixed offset.
Input parameter tokenId_ of bubbleBudsGenesisId, a packed uint holding the raw id in bits 40..199.
Local variable _rawId holding the masked and right-shifted value (tokenId_ & 0xffffffffffffff0000000000) >> 40.
Local variable _fixedId holding the corrected genesis id returned by the function.
Bitwise operations on id_ (id_ >> 96 address prefix comparison and id_ & 0xff..ff low-order equality check) used as the validity predicate.
Unsigned subtraction _rawId - 2 which underflows (reverting in 0.8.x, or wrapping in unchecked contexts) when _rawId < 2.

edges.reason: The parameter id_ is the sole input consumed by isValidBubbleBudz.
id_ flows into the bitwise shift/mask validity checks.
The result of the bitwise checks determines the boolean returned by the function.
Failure of the prefix or low-order bitwise check short-circuits and returns false early.
The parameter tokenId_ is the sole input consumed by bubbleBudsGenesisId.
tokenId_ is masked and shifted to produce the local _rawId.
_rawId is the left operand of the subtraction _rawId - 2, which can underflow.
The subtraction result is assigned to the local _fixedId, carrying any underflow value.
_fixedId is returned directly to the caller, propagating the arithmetic result out of the function.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter id_ has no independent security identity; it is fully subsumed by the isValidBubbleBudz entry point it feeds.
The parameter tokenId_ exists only as the input of bubbleBudsGenesisId and should be folded into that function node.
_rawId is an intermediate temporary whose only role is to feed the subtraction operation, so it collapses into that unsafe operation.
_fixedId is a short-lived temporary returned by the function, so it collapses into the bubbleBudsGenesisId return path.
